svg.aria-label: EFZ-ESP32S3 wired to the 1.8 inch ST7735 LCD: top header 3V3, GPIO15, GPIO14, GPIO13, GND to LCD VCC, SCL, SDA, RES, GND; bottom header GPIO40, GPIO39, GPIO38 to DC, CS, BL
svg.text: Wiring the 1.8″ ST7735 LCD to the EFZ-ESP32S3
Board with USB-C on the left, LCD upright on the right, 8 jumper wires.
Rev 1 board: the labels printed on the top header are one pin off. Follow the GPIO chips here, counting from 3V3 on the left.
